defense_injuries.espn_comment: questionable
Hawkins (knee) was limited during Thursday's practice.
Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.
Bateman (calf) was limited in practice Thursday.
Isaac (hamstring) is questionable to return to Thursday night's contest against the Jaguars.
Starks finished Baltimore's Week 9 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday with four tackles (three solo) and a forced fumble.
Wiggins (illness) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
Smith finished with eight tackles (two solo) in Thursday's Week 9 loss to Jacksonville.
Hamilton (hip) practiced in full Thursday.
Flowers brought in three of six targets for six yards and rushed three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
Fagnano completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while adding three rushes for 13 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
Lane did not draw a target Thursday in a loss to Jacksonville.
The Ravens aren't expected to deal Henry before Tuesday's trade deadline, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Hill rushed nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.
Walker didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.
Cuevas didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.
Hibner logged one reception for five yards on two targets in Thursday's loss to Baltimore.
Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday against the Chargers, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.
The Ravens acquired Neuzil from the Falcons on Tuesday in exchange for guard Andrew Vorhees and a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
Patterson will be the Ravens' kicker for Monday night's game against the Chargers, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
